contractFacts.Blueprint10: Each public candidate SEO>=90/GEO>=85/AEO>=90 plus source/truth/collision/inbound/parent/technical gates. Numeric weighting formula is not supplied by the retained contracts.
contractFacts.A04: Each primary title_alignment_score>=90; exact evidence and reproducible rubric; arbitrary author self-score insufficient.
contractFacts.v12_17: All named content, CTA, image and architecture/HTML/sitemap gates remain mandatory. A score cannot offset one.

normalization: HTML entity decode; Unicode NFC; all whitespace runs to one ASCII space; trim. Retain punctuation and count Unicode codepoints. Exact original strings and first120/first180 are stored in static-observations.json.
scoring: Only directly inspected evidence earns full criterion weight; FAIL earns0; untested REQUIRED earns0 verified points and remains PENDING. Never rebase denominator to tested-only criteria or pass by averaging pages. Verified points are review coverage under this disclosed internal rubric, not Google/Naver/LLM performance.

Contains allowed purchase decision token, not unrelated informational intent

Title begins at codepoint 0 with the complete primary query, without promotional modifiers between geography/facility and service. It precedes the purchase explanation and brand. For any later non-prefix proposal, fail this criterion pending review.
Contains same allowed service; no scope drift

Hidden or skipped earlier static lead

criteria.criterion: One defined primary query/intent and traceable query evidence; missing keyword metadata explicitly supplemented and hash-bound in this review.
A04 static title/H1/firstAnswer >=90 and no hard alignment failure.
Unique title/meta, one H1, coherent H2/H3; actual used summary passes separation rules.
Actual local/vertical facts and supported catalog; no invented claim.
Real internal targets/inbound/breadcrumb and distinct home/detail buyer decisions.
Provider-led full-copy information and real HTML phone/SKU action links, not image-only actions.
Local assets exist; descriptive alt/sample labeling; exact approved banner exception.
Production canonical/robots/OG/Twitter/sitemap/map agree for approved origin.
Actual production HTTP200/404 and correct resource/CTA endpoint responses verified against this output.
Browser mobile/desktop readability, computed FAQ visibility and action usability verified.

GEO.meaning: Internal source-grounded, attributable document quality for generative use; not a measurement of AI citation/ranking and not a claim that GEO is only geographic optimization.

criteria.criterion: Provider, venue and service entities unambiguous; provider contact distinguished from facility contacts.
Every material venue/catalog/policy assertion traced to inspected primary-source content; original dates and source level retained.
Useful local/order content, not place-name substitution or decorative local history.
Conditions and uncertainty explicit; prices not total, sample not exact fulfillment, no fake delivery/refund/affiliation proof.
Readable semantic source/answer sections and meaningful, non-conflicting page roles; no invented review/schema evidence.
Within180 codepoints first answer states actual relevant offer and buyer step; core answer begins within120.
Role-specific questions answered: home discovery/price/contact, detail venue/product/price/ribbon/order/change/collection; no word-count filler.
Answer facts and conditional policies have primary evidence without overclaiming.
Main HTML contains complete answers with sensible headings, and each specified FAQ appears once; home has no quota FAQ requirement.
Actionable next step uses exact seller phone or SKU destination and helpful provider tone.
Actual browser computed visibility/readability confirms static answer/FAQ/CTA extraction.

notApplicablePages.regions-support: One noindex support child only, no independent query; content/link/robots and used article card checked, not scored as a third primary.
notApplicablePages.not-found: Technical error recovery, not scored as content/article; real HTTP404 remains mandatory technical verification.

scoreMeaning: Verified evidence points under this disclosed internal review rubric, not search demand, Google/Naver ranking, AI citation probability, or launch permission.

definitionReuse.retained: Same criterion IDs, weights, fixed100 denominators, thresholds, zero-for-pending, exact primary-query prefix interpretation and LCS summary test. No prior regional text or scores imported.
